sources.quote: Service and aftermarket parts are not in scope of this record.
APPROVAL AP-0311: part BR-220; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese); billet grade EN AW-6082-T6; status APPROVED 2026-07-20 (PPAP-2026-118, drawing Rev C)
Service parts are governed by a separate document, STL-CSR-SP-01, which is not part of this excerpt.

findings.why: Alluminio B is approved for BR-220 for series production at TO1 for STL, but the ASL does not cover service or aftermarket parts. No controlled record in the documents covers BR-220 as a service part, so a person must confirm whether an approval exists. This is not a finding that the source is unapproved. The STL service-part requirements (STL-CSR-SP-01) were also not provided.

sources.quote: Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Yield strength Rp0.2 | >= 250 MPa, SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01 | Certificate review plus tensile test, 1 specimen per heat
Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: The proposal covers an Alluminio B billet already in stock. The documents contain no certificate and no test result for that lot. They do not show its grade or temper. Drawing Rev C requires EN AW-6082-T6 with Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01) and a type 3.1 certificate for each lot. Someone must supply the certificate for this stock lot.
